title: [29.X]-Modifying Description resets Quantity to 1 on Purchase Invoice Lines
summary: Fixed an issue where modifying the description field on purchase invoice and credit memo lines would unexpectedly reset the quantity to 1.
key_points: Quantity field was being reset when description was edited on purchase document lines
Issue affected both purchase invoices and credit memos
Fix applied to the subform pages handling these documents
Test case added to verify the corrected behavior
